title: Keel Agent Phase Output
description: Contract for the output file each Keel phase agent writes to .keel/state/<story-id>/<NN>-<agent>.json. This is how agents pass context to each other.

agent.description: tdd-red and tdd-green are DEPRECATED (legacy <=v3.12); accepted for validating old state files only, not for new stories.

story_id.description: Story identifier, e.g. FEAT-1 or HART-287

text.description: Human-readable finding description. Reference file paths and identifiers — never inline file contents.

severity.description: CRITICAL/HIGH findings block PASS if OPEN. MEDIUM/LOW do not block.

state.description: Terminal state. OPEN blocks PASS if severity CRITICAL/HIGH. RESOLVED requires commit verification. DEFERRED/WAIVED require human approval.

evidence.description: Evidence for the state transition (optional, populated by keel state finding --set-state)

commit.description: Git commit SHA that resolved this finding

deferred_to.description: Phase or future ticket this was deferred to

reason.description: Verbatim reason for deferral or waiver (>= 15 words)

findings.description: Findings from this phase: defects, performance issues, security concerns, etc. Each finding has severity and state. CRITICAL/HIGH findings at OPEN block pipeline advancement.

acceptance_criteria_ids.description: Acceptance criteria this phase addresses. Phase 1 (product-owner) defines the full set; every later phase must account for all of them. Dropping an AC without a documented descope decision is drift and fails the handshake gate.

decisions.description: Decisions made this phase with one-line rationale (audited)

artifacts.description: Repo-relative paths to files this phase produced or changed

next_phase.description: Phase that should run next; null when the pipeline is complete

blockers.description: Anything preventing the next phase from starting

design_review_checklist.description: Phase 3 (UI designer) required review checklist. Must pass all items for gate C-0008 to PASS.

story_alignment.description: Design aligns with story requirements and user flows

wcag_2_1_aa.description: Design meets WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility compliance

responsive_design.description: Layout works on mobile (375px), tablet (768px), desktop (1200px+)

design_tokens.description: All colors, spacing, typography use design system tokens (not hardcoded values)

palette_typography.description: Color palette and typography specs documented (min 2 font families, max 5 colors primary)

tokens_used.description: Optional token usage self-reported by the agent (for cost-tracking dashboard T1-1)

area.description: Category of assumption: scope, data shape, user behavior, performance target, or security boundary

assumption.description: The assumption itself (e.g., 'payment processing is fast <2s', 'user IDs are UUIDs')

risk.description: Risk if the assumption is false (e.g., 'feature fails on slow networks', 'migration needs rewrite')

assumptions.description: K-1: Assumptions surfaced before planning (phase 5 software-engineer only). Required: minItems 1 for phase 5.

ac_id.description: Acceptance criterion ID that was ambiguous

options.description: At least 2 plausible readings of this AC. Phase-1 blockers labeled ambiguous must appear here.

interpretations_considered.description: K-2: Interpretations considered for ambiguous ACs (phase 5 software-engineer only). Required: one entry per ambiguous AC.

implementation_plan_path.description: K-3: Path to implementation plan file (phase 5 software-engineer only). Must exist and contain required sections.
